title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Provisions of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China Relating to Credit Cards

articles.content_en:
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, in light of the circumstances encountered in judicial practice, has deliberated on the issue of the meaning of "credit card" as provided in the Criminal Law. The interpretation is as follows: "Credit card" as provided in the Criminal Law means an electronic payment card issued by commercial banks or other financial institutions that possesses all or part of the functions such as consumer payment, credit loan, transfer settlement, and cash deposit and withdrawal.
It is hereby announced.
